ร.definition: The 35th letter of 44 Thai alphabet, Ror-Ruea. [Pronounced] like Spanish/Italian/[Indonesian]/Malay "R" and commonly written like S in many Thai signs, but please do not include the letter for your terrible [aesthetics] and define your word.
ร.example:
Naรty = Narty != Nasty. And narty means ski board in Polish.
รɛx = Rex != Sex.
yɛรtɛʀɗɑy = Yerterday != [Yesterday]. And yerter = wheelrim in Tocharian ([I don't know what] is this [language]). Day of wheelrim.
รuรiɛ = Rurie != Susie.
wɑร = War != Was.
Doing the narty = Having Rex => Doing the skiboard = Having Rex. Thanks, I'll try it, I want a dinosaur.
